title: AIR Prompt Edition Manifest

LEGACY_HUMAN_READABLE.label: Legacy / Familiar AIR
LEGACY_HUMAN_READABLE.purpose: Byte-preserved verbose prompt edition for existing users, manual attachment, audit, learning, and compatibility.

MAIN_MACHINE_OPTIMIZED.label: Main / Machine-Optimized AIR
MAIN_MACHINE_OPTIMIZED.purpose: Compiled, dependency-closed, task-specific AIR representation with equivalent or stricter governing behavior.

invariants: Legacy and main editions share mandatory governance invariant identifiers.
Legacy is a representation and compatibility edition, not legacy governance.
No edition may hide a material gate, blocker, evidence requirement, or approval scope.
Main becomes default only after structural, semantic, cross-edition, and behavioral regression validation.
Root compatibility paths are not removed until a separately approved migration release.
Specialist edition splits are required only where representation differs; shared source registries may remain common.
A source change affecting shared governance must trigger validation of both editions.
